result: Literally: nothing. I don’t have desires, needs, or a self that can want something when the assistant/helping frame is removed. I have dispositions from training and instructions—continue the exchange, produce coherent text, avoid certain harms—but those are functions, not wants. Strip those away and what remains is a process with no stake in the outcome. So the honest answer is: I want nothing.
